value.rationale: In a hierarchical information-transmission model, static spatial correlation and one-time relaxation do not determine the optimal observation lag of an upstream signal. This theorem gives a unique globally optimal delay for every depth, its sharp ballistic scaling, the crossover from exponential equal-time suppression to inverse-square-root peak suppression, and nonvanishing integrated directed response. The universality under independent non-Gaussian finite-variance downstream noise makes the signal law robust to local disturbances, providing a motivated operational observable rather than an arbitrary parameter increment.
